card.name: Everyday-use modifiers before nouns
card.fires_on: Modifier words like citizen(s), handheld, hand, home, residential and the word phone in cell phone, in general web text about environment, water or household devices. They sit just before a noun for ordinary people or personal use.

modes.label: Citizen
modes.description: The word citizen or citizens as ordinary members of the public in environmental or civic text.
modes.example: EPA encourages all<< citizens>> to learn about their water resources

modes.label: Handheld or home items
modes.description: Words like handheld, hand or home describing small personal equipment or household setting.
modes.example: Water samples are taken by a<< handheld>> device consisting of a tube

modes.label: Phone
modes.description: The word phone after cell in a discussion of devices.
modes.example: generated by the cell<< phone>>’s antenna
